```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# 1. Read the metadata
dt <- read.csv('meta.csv', stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# 2. Start the table
cat('<table class="table" style="width:100%;">')
cat('<thead><tr>
      <th>Screenshot</th>
      <th>Repo Name</th>
      <th>Visualization</th>
      <th>Project Title</th>
      <th>Last Updated</th>
    </tr></thead><tbody>')

for(i in 1:nrow(dt)){
  repo <- gsub("aakritixyz/", "", trimws(dt$viz_owner_repo[i]))
  
  # CLEAN URL LOGIC: No square brackets, just pure strings
  # This prevents Pandoc from getting confused
  base_url <- paste0("https://", "aakritixyz.github.io/", repo, "/")
  img_url  <- paste0(base_url, "Capture.PNG")
  source_url <- trimws(dt$source[i])
  
  cat('<tr>')
  
  # Column 1: Screenshot (Linked to Demo)
  cat('<td><a href="', base_url, '">', sep="")
  cat('<img src="', img_url, '" width="250" style="border:1px solid #ddd; border-radius:4px;">', sep="")
  cat('</a></td>')
  
  # Column 2: Repo Name (Linked to GitHub Source)
  cat('<td style="vertical-align: middle; font-family: monospace;">')
  cat('<a href="', source_url, '" target="_blank" style="text-decoration: underline;">', repo, '</a>', sep="")
  cat('</td>')
  
  # Column 3: Visualization (Button)
  cat('<td style="vertical-align: middle;">')
  cat('<a href="', base_url, '" class="btn btn-sm btn-success" target="_blank">Interactive Demo</a>', sep="")
  cat('</td>')
  
  # Column 4: Project Title
  cat('<td style="vertical-align: middle;"><b>', dt$title[i], '</b></td>', sep="")
  
  # Column 5: Last Updated
  cat('<td style="vertical-align: middle; color: #666; font-size: 0.85em;">')
  cat(format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"))
  cat('</td>')
  
  cat('</tr>')
}

cat('</tbody></table>')

cat('<br><hr><h3>Source Code</h3>')
cat('<ul><li><a href="https://github.com/aakritixyz/animint-gallery">Repository of this gallery</a></li></ul>')
